sloka: स कृत्तचापः शरताडितश्च मेदार्द्रगात्रो रुधिरावसिक्तः ।जग्राह शक्तिं समुदग्रशक्तिः स्वयम्भुदत्तां युधि देवशत्रुः ।। ६.५९.१०७ ।।।।
transliteration: sa kṛttacāpaḥ śaratāḍitaśca medārdragātro rudhirāvasiktaḥ ।jagrāha śaktiṁ samudagraśaktiḥ svayambhudattāṁ yudhi devaśatruḥ ।। 6.59.107 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Lakshmana son of Dasaratha, struck the bow of the king into pieces with three sharp and pointed arrows. The king swooned and recovered with great difficulty.
